title: Multiples of complete local sections are complete
statement: On a small ringed site with commutative coefficient sheaf R and derived object K, if f is complete on U in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-complete-element], then a*f is complete for every a in R(U).

source.place: Tags 0997 and 0998, original proof step 2; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 08J9 and 08JC.

proof.text: The tensor product of the sequential localization diagrams has diagonal transition multiplication by a*f. Tensor preserves their colimits and the diagonal of N x N is final, giving L(a*f) isomorphic to L(a) tensor L(f). Show each localization flat using exact filtered colimits of flat unit modules.

source.place: Tags 0997 and 0998, original proof step 2; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 08J9 and 08JC.

proof.text: Choose a K-injective representative I for K restricted to U. The single complex L(f) is bounded above and flat, hence K-flat. Its Hom complex into I is K-injective and represents the zero derived object.

proof.text: Use total tensor-Hom currying and the degree-zero tensor comparison. The outer RHom applied to the inner zero object vanishes by its exactness, proving the required vanishing.
